``` ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false source("scripts/cargar_datos.R") col_ori <- if ("continente_norm" %in% names(arboles)) "continente_norm" else "continente" tr_forma <- c("Conífera"="Conifer", "Árbol latifoliado"="Broadleaf tree", "Arbusto"="Shrub", "Palmera"="Palm", "Otro"="Other") tr_ori <- c("América del Norte"="North America", "América del Sur"="South America", "América Central"="Central America", "Hemisferio Norte"="Northern Hemisphere", "Hemisferio Sur"="Southern Hemisphere", "Varias regiones"="Various regions", "Europa"="Europe", "Asia"="Asia", "África"="Africa", "Oceanía"="Oceania", "Australasia"="Australasia") tr_map <- function(x, dic) { out <- unname(dic[as.character(x)]); ifelse(is.na(out), as.character(x), out) } df <- arboles %>% mutate( nombre_mostrar = dplyr::case_when( tiene_valor(nombre_comun) ~ nombre_comun, tiene_valor(nombre_cientifico) ~ nombre_cientifico, TRUE ~ ID ), sci = ifelse(tiene_valor(nombre_cientifico), nombre_cientifico, ""), aut = ifelse(tiene_valor(autor), autor, ""), fam = ifelse(tiene_valor(familia), familia, "—"), grp = ifelse(tiene_valor(forma_vida), tr_map(forma_vida, tr_forma), "Unclassified"), ori = ifelse(tiene_valor(.data[[col_ori]]), tr_map(.data[[col_ori]], tr_ori), "No data"), con = ifelse(nzchar(iucn), iucn, ""), con_html = iucn_badge(iucn, "en"), clave = gsub("^[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "", toupper(iconv(nombre_mostrar, to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT"))) ) %>% arrange(clave) # Conservation selector, ordered by threat (not alphabetical) sel_con <- paste0( "", paste0(vapply(c("EN","VU","NT","LC"), function(k) sprintf("", k, iucn_label(k, "en")), character(1)), collapse = "") ) esc <- function(x) { x <- as.character(x) x <- gsub("&", "&", x, fixed = TRUE) x <- gsub("<", "<", x, fixed = TRUE) x <- gsub(">", ">", x, fixed = TRUE) gsub('"', """, x, fixed = TRUE) } opciones <- function(vals) paste0( "", paste0("", collapse = "") ) ``` Explore the `r nrow(df)` specimens. Type in the search box or combine the filters; each name opens its profile.

Download catalogue (CSV) Open data · free to use with attribution

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## About this data and conservation status The flora survey is **ongoing**. Some species were identified from **nursery purchase records** and are **not yet verified in the field**; identifications may be corrected as fieldwork progresses. The **Conservation** column shows the **IUCN Red List** category for assessed species (at the global species level, not for the individual specimen): ```{r results='asis', echo=FALSE} cat('
', paste(vapply(c("EN","VU","NT","LC"), function(k) iucn_badge(k, "en"), character(1)), collapse = " "), '
') ``` Source: [IUCN Red List of Threatened Species](https://www.iucnredlist.org). Species without a badge have no assessment assigned in this catalogue (for example, specimens identified only to genus). ::: ```{r results='asis', echo=FALSE} cat(sprintf('
', opciones(sort(unique(df$fam[df$fam != "—"]))), opciones(sort(unique(df$grp))), opciones(sort(unique(df$ori))), sel_con )) for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) { r <- df[i, ] buscar <- tolower(iconv(paste(r$nombre_mostrar, r$sci), to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT")) cat(sprintf( '\n', esc(r$fam), esc(r$grp), esc(r$ori), esc(r$con), esc(buscar), esc(r$slug), esc(r$nombre_mostrar), sci_html(r$sci, r$aut), esc(r$fam), esc(r$grp), esc(r$ori), r$con_html )) } cat('
Common nameScientific nameFamilyTypeOriginConservation
%s%s%s%s%s%s
') ```
